## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive (positive: Consumer Discretionary, Communication, Technology, Consumer Staples, Financials, Healthcare, Energy; negative: Materials, Industrials, Real Estate, Utilities). Confirmation: (1) Sector breadth is mixed at 7/11 and (2) major divergence across large-cap techs and cyclicals (MSFT strong vs AAPL/AMD/QCOM weak) — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Discretionary leads: AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, BKNG (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strong: CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND. Technology momentum this week: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weakest: VST (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate under pressure: VTR (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION, WELL (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION. Industrials soft: CAT (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -4.86%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +12.94% | 1M: -8.55%) RECOVERY; ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology-heavy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: LIN (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND; ASML (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%) BELOW TREND; CAT (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND; QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-leverage industrials and select semiconductors.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.94% | 1M: -8.55%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +12.60% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence where mega-cap tech strength this week contrasts with several marquee names in CORRECTION/BELOW TREND — watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but intraday momentum; MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND and ADBE (1W: +11.24% | 1M: +18.69%) ABOVE TREND show leadership, while AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION, ASML (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND highlight dispersion; Technology is one of the positive sectors this week but with mixed 1M signals.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials steady but not exuberant; V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +4.29%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +6.20% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +5.78%) CORRECTION — breadth supportive but signals mixed between short and medium term.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare shows selective strength on news: PFE (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND — sector buoyed by multiple bullish catalysts but internals are mixed.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to momentum leaders (MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND pressure (AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION, QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed — growth momentum this week but structural divergence warrants selectivity and monitoring.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND; PFE (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (7/11 positive overall) and Technology (momentum names leading this week) — monitor for follow-through. BEARISH: Utilities and Industrials (both negative this week) as barometers for risk appetite deterioration.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch MSFT sustaining this week’s breakout to confirm ABOVE TREND momentum; monitor AAPL’s recent 1W low as a CORRECTION resolution trigger; NVDA (1W: -2.94% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION — a breakdown in NVDA would signal broader tech risk; JPM needs to clear recent resistance to confirm Financials continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PFE (+85): Pfizer Q2 beat and raised guidance; PFE (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. JNJ (+85): FDA nod for robotics; JNJ (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION — bullish news but short-term price lagging (divergence). BA (+80): FAA approval headlines; BA (1W: +3.16% | 1M: -1.12%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with 1W strength.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (-50): Google exec warning on AI spending; GOOGL (1W: +11.38% | 1M: -1.41%) RECOVERY — negative headline but price is rising this week (divergence). WMT (-50): downgrade ahead of earnings; WMT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.19%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment negative yet price holding (divergence).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION and QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND are showing weakness. Key risk: major divergence between mega-cap winners this week and multiple large names in CORRECTION/BELOW TREND, with mixed sentiment-confirmation across healthcare and tech to monitor.
